capabilities: Convert pasted links into markdown embed syntax
Render iframes for supported sites like Spotify, Reddit, X, and CodePen
Set embed width and height via markdown options
Disable embedding per link with the noembed option
Resize embeds from resize messages sent by sites
extras: README flags site-specific limitations (Spotify limited to 30-second previews, Reddit share links unsupported, Notion requires a published page) and Live Preview editing glitches; installation instructions are still listed as TODO; development is supported via Ko-fi.
intentEvidence: Inspired by Sam Warnick's Simple Embed. It was archived so I made my own plugin.
motivation: The author's predecessor plugin, Simple Embed by Sam Warnick, was archived, so they built their own version with many changes.
problem: Embedding unsupported websites in Obsidian loads the full page rather than focused content, and the native embed offers no width or height options.

relations.evidence: It was archived so I made my own plugin. Changed a lot of things from it though.

summary: Plugin that converts pasted website links into markdown embed syntax and renders them as iframes for sites like Spotify, Reddit, and CodePen.
